tools.name: create_niagara_system
tools.description: Create a new blank Niagara System asset at the specified content path.

tools.name: create_niagara_data_channel
tools.description: Create a new Niagara Data Channel asset at the specified content path for high-frequency decoupled event broadcasting.

tools.name: create_niagara_effect_type
tools.description: Create a new Niagara Effect Type asset at the specified content path for system scalability, distance culling, and LOD budgeting.

tools.name: add_niagara_emitter
tools.description: Create or copy an emitter and append it to an existing Niagara System.

system_path.description: Content path of the target Niagara System, e.g. /Game/Effects/NS_Explosion

emitter_template.description: The template emitter or asset to copy (e.g. 'SpriteBurst', 'RibbonTrail', 'MeshDebris', 'GPUSimulation', or an asset path to an existing Niagara System or Niagara Emitter).

emitter_name.description: Desired unique name for the new emitter handle inside the system.

source_emitter_name.description: Optional: Name of the specific emitter to extract when copying from a multi-emitter Niagara System.

tools.name: add_niagara_module
tools.description: Dynamically add a logic module (e.g. AddVelocity, GravityForce, Drag, Collision, AccelerationForce, LightRenderer) to a specific phase of an emitter or system stack graph.

system_path.description: Content path of the target Niagara System

emitter_name.description: Name of the emitter inside the system to modify. Required for emitter phases, omitted for system phases.

phase.description: The script execution phase/stack layer where the module will be added.

module_type.description: The Niagara module to add to the script stack (e.g. stock name like 'AddVelocity', 'GravityForce', 'Drag', 'Collision', 'AccelerationForce', or an arbitrary Niagara module script asset path).

suggested_name.description: Optional human-readable label or alias for the newly added module node in the stack.

target_index.description: Optional 0-based insertion index within the phase stack. If omitted or -1, appends to the end of the stack.

tools.name: set_niagara_module_pin
tools.description: Configure an input pin value or link a parameter on a specific module inside an emitter or system phase.

system_path.description: Content path of the target Niagara System

emitter_name.description: Name of the emitter inside the system. Required for emitter phases, omitted for system phases.

phase.description: The execution phase containing the module

module_type.description: The type of the module containing the pin, e.g. AddVelocity

module_index.description: Optional 0-based index when multiple modules of the same type exist in the phase stack.

node_guid.description: Optional node GUID string to uniquely target a specific module node.

pin_name.description: Name of the input pin to edit (e.g., Velocity, Gravity, Drag, Size)

value.description: Literal constant to assign to the pin: e.g. '1.5' (float), '(X=0.0,Y=0.0,Z=-980.0)' (Vector), '(R=1.0,G=0.0,B=0.0,A=1.0)' (Color). Either 'value', 'link_parameter', 'asset_path', 'properties', or 'curve_keys' must be provided.

link_parameter.description: Parameter handle name to bind to this pin (e.g. 'User.MyColor', 'Particles.Age'). When provided, links the input to this parameter instead of using literal value. Either 'value', 'link_parameter', 'asset_path', 'properties', or 'curve_keys' must be provided.

asset_path.description: Asset content path to assign directly to a Data Interface or UObject module input pin (e.g. '/Game/VFX/NDC_Impacts' or a StaticMesh/Texture path).

asset_property_name.description: Optional property name on the data interface to assign the asset to (e.g. 'DataChannelAsset', 'DefaultMesh', 'Channel', 'Source'). If omitted, automatically matches to the first compatible property.

interface_class.description: Optional Data Interface class name (e.g. 'NiagaraDataInterfaceDataChannelRead', 'NiagaraDataInterfaceStaticMesh', 'NiagaraDataInterfaceCurve') when configuring a Data Interface pin directly.

properties.description: Optional map of property names and values to assign to the direct Data Interface instance.

curve_keys.description: For curve data interfaces (NiagaraDataInterfaceCurve, NiagaraDataInterfaceColorCurve, etc.): an array of {time, value} objects for single-channel curves, or an object mapping channel names (e.g. 'Red', 'Green', 'Blue', 'Alpha') to arrays of {time, value} objects for multi-channel curves.

tools.name: reset_niagara_module_pin
tools.description: Reset a Niagara module input pin back to its autogenerated default, removing any override pin, disconnecting and deleting exclusive upstream input nodes, and pruning orphaned graph nodes.

system_path.description: Content path of the target Niagara System

emitter_name.description: Name of the emitter inside the system. Required for emitter phases, omitted for system phases.

phase.description: The execution phase containing the module

module_type.description: The type of the module containing the pin, e.g. 'AddVelocity' or 'Drag'

pin_name.description: Name of the input pin to reset

clean_orphaned_nodes.description: Whether to clean up orphaned input nodes in the phase graph after resetting the pin. Default: true.

tools.name: compile_niagara_system
tools.description: Compile the script graphs of the target Niagara System and retrieve errors, warnings, and performance bottleneck diagnostics.

system_path.description: Content path of the target Niagara System to compile

tools.name: capture_niagara_system_isolated
tools.description: Perform an isolated scene capture of the Niagara system simulation over time, returning a 2x2 grid image of 4 chronologically spaced keyframes with dynamic time and scale overlays, as well as spatial bounds dimension metadata.

system_path.description: Content path of the target Niagara System to render

duration_seconds.description: Total simulation window to capture over (default: 2.0 seconds). Slices will occur at 10%, 30%, 60%, and 90% of this window.

max_dimension.description: Maximum width/height of the output grid image in pixels (default 512, range 256-1024).

tools.name: set_niagara_parameter
tools.description: Set a User parameter value or dynamic curve on a UNiagaraSystem asset. Note: System and Emitter scopes are graph-internal and cannot be added to the asset parameter store directly; configure module pins via set_niagara_module_pin or link them to a User parameter.

system_path.description: Content path of the target UNiagaraSystem asset, e.g. /Game/Effects/NS_Explosion. Alias for SystemAsset.

SystemAsset.description: Object path of UNiagaraSystem asset. Alias for system_path.

parameter_scope.description: Parameter store scope ('User'). System and Emitter scopes are rejected as they are graph-internal. Alias for ParameterScope.

ParameterScope.description: Parameter store scope ('User'). System and Emitter scopes are rejected as they are graph-internal. Alias for parameter_scope.

parameter_name.description: Name of parameter to set (e.g. 'SpawnRate', 'PrimaryColor', 'User.SpawnRate'). Alias for ParameterName.

ParameterName.description: Name of parameter to set (e.g. 'SpawnRate', 'PrimaryColor'). Alias for parameter_name.

data_type.description: Niagara parameter data type. Default: 'Float'. Alias for DataType.

DataType.description: Niagara parameter data type. Default: 'Float'. Alias for data_type.

asset_path.description: Asset content path for Object, DataChannelAsset, or DataInterface parameter binding (e.g. '/Game/VFX/NDC_Impacts').

value.description: Constant scalar, vector, color, bool, or int value payload (e.g. '500.0', '1.0, 0.0, 0.0', true). Alias for Value.

Value.description: Constant scalar, vector, color, bool, or int value payload. Alias for value.

curve_keys.description: Array of curve keyframes for CurveFloat or CurveLinearColor data types. Alias for CurveKeys.

Time.description: Keyframe time index. Alias for time.

time.description: Keyframe time index. Alias for Time.

Value.description: Keyframe float value. Alias for value.

value.description: Keyframe float value. Alias for Value.

CurveKeys.description: Array of curve keyframes for CurveFloat or CurveLinearColor data types. Alias for curve_keys.

Time.description: Keyframe time index. Alias for time.

time.description: Keyframe time index. Alias for Time.

Value.description: Keyframe float value. Alias for value.

value.description: Keyframe float value. Alias for Value.

tools.name: set_niagara_data_interface
tools.description: Create and bind a Niagara Data Interface (e.g. Data Channel, Static Mesh, Audio, Curve) to a Niagara System parameter in User scope. Note: Non-User scopes like 'Emitter.' or 'System.' are rejected as data interfaces must be exposed as User parameters.

system_path.description: Content path of the target Niagara System

parameter_name.description: Name of the parameter to bind (e.g. 'DataChannel', 'User.DataChannel', 'MeshDI')

interface_class.description: Data Interface class name (e.g. 'NiagaraDataInterfaceDataChannelRead', 'NiagaraDataInterfaceDataChannelWrite', 'NiagaraDataInterfaceStaticMesh'). Alias: data_interface_class.

asset_path.description: Optional asset content path to assign to the data interface (e.g. a UNiagaraDataChannelAsset or StaticMesh path).

asset_property_name.description: Optional property name on the data interface to assign the asset to (e.g. 'DataChannelAsset', 'DefaultMesh', 'Channel', 'Source'). If omitted, automatically matches to the first compatible property.

properties.description: Optional map of property names and values to assign to the data interface instance.

tools.name: add_niagara_renderer
tools.description: Add a renderer (e.g. Light, Sprite, Ribbon, Mesh, Decal, Component) to an emitter within a Niagara System.

system_path.description: Content path of the target Niagara System

emitter_name.description: Name of the emitter inside the system to add the renderer to

renderer_type.description: Type or class of renderer to add to the emitter (e.g. 'Light', 'Sprite', 'Ribbon', 'Mesh', 'Decal', 'Component', or full class name like 'NiagaraDecalRendererProperties').

target_index.description: Optional 0-based insertion index in the emitter's renderers list.

properties.description: Optional map of property names and values to configure on the new renderer instance.

tools.name: list_niagara_parameters
tools.description: List all parameters, module input overrides, curve keys, and bound data interfaces across Niagara parameter scopes (User, System, Emitter, ModuleInput, GraphInput, or All).

system_path.description: Content path of the target UNiagaraSystem asset, e.g. /Game/Effects/NS_Explosion

scope.description: Filter parameter inspection to a specific scope ('all', 'User', 'System', 'Emitter', 'ModuleInput', 'GraphInput'). Default: 'all'.

emitter_name.description: Optional emitter name to filter Emitter or ModuleInput scope parameters.

include_module_inputs.description: Whether to include module input overrides when inspecting System, Emitter, or All scopes. Default: true.

include_orphaned_nodes.description: Whether to detect and include orphaned graph input nodes. Default: true.

tools.name: remove_niagara_parameter
tools.description: Remove a parameter from a UNiagaraSystem parameter store by name.

system_path.description: Content path of the target UNiagaraSystem asset, e.g. /Game/Effects/NS_Explosion

parameter_name.description: Name of the parameter to remove, e.g. 'MyParam' or 'User.MyParam'
